calls.title: Comcast <> Growthbook: Discovery Call
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences, focusing on discussed product/features/pain points, key participants/roles, and next steps/action items.

Key participants: Jake Heier (GrowthBook account team), Cris Dizon (GrowthBook CS), Ryan McGurk (CRO), Graham (co-founder), Milind Deshpande (Comcast, manages Breeze platform), Craig Murray (Comcast, AXP team), Akhilesh Camisetty (engineer), Lewis Goettner (engineer). Comcast uses Breeze (experimentation platform wrapper on Split/Harness). Pain points: high cost for scaling experiments to anonymous/unauthenticated users, desire to reduce licensing barriers, need for warehouse-native analytics, Open Feature integration, SSO (SAML), on-prem deployment, C SDK support. GrowthBook demoed its open-source platform with feature flags, experiments, warehouse-native (supports Databricks), RBAC, multi-arm bandits, AI summaries, etc.

Next steps: Milind asked for 1-2 weeks to evaluate internally, then follow-up meeting to discuss technical gaps and pricing.

Summary: Comcast's Breeze team (Milind, Craig, Akhilesh) wants to expand experimentation cheaply using an open-source platform like GrowthBook to overcome cost and licensing barriers of current vendor tools (Split/Harness). Key participants included Jake, Cris, Ryan, and Graham from GrowthBook,
